observations: 768 aa sequence; predicted mass 85.3 kDa and theoretical pI 9.55.
Best reviewed homolog is Emericella nidulans PIF1 (UniProt Q5AXT5): 50.2% identity, 73.4% query coverage, E-value 4.54e-156.
Pfam detects PIF1-family helicase domain at residues 412–614 and Pif1_2B domain at 679–720; ATPase/helicase annotations are homology-based.

Homolog annotations support ATP-dependent 5′→3′ DNA helicase activity, ATP hydrolysis with Mg2+, and roles in DNA repair, recombination, replication-fork reversal, telomere maintenance, and genome stability.
